Bug_Details: Duration APIs only work for DAYS or exact durations. Duration APIs only work for TemporalUnits with exact durations or ChronoUnit.DAYS. E.g., Duration.of(1, ChronoUnit.YEARS) is guaranteed to throw a DateTimeException.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is demonstrated by attempting to create a Duration using a TemporalUnit that is not supported. Duration.of with ChronoUnit.YEARS will throw a DateTimeException because Duration only supports exact durations and ChronoUnit.DAYS.
Trigger_Explanation: The testShowBug method invokes the showBug method of DurationExample, which contains a line creating a Duration with ChronoUnit.YEARS. This triggers a DateTimeException because Duration only supports exact durations and ChronoUnit.DAYS.
